front: Effect of soil temperature on germination
back: Enzymes work fastest at an optimum temperature; cold soil delays germination, very hot soil damages the embryo.

front: Effect of soil temperature on soil organisms
back: Decomposition and nitrification speed up in warm, moist soil and nearly stop in cold soil.

front: Which slopes are warmer in Zimbabwe?

back: A low-lying area where cold, dense air collects on still nights, so frost is likely.

front: Effect of an organic mulch on soil temperature
back: Cooler by day, warmer at night: it reduces the extremes.
